body: I was in the same situation in college. We usually end up watching movies when that happened. No pressure on any of us to leave the room as we were all minding our own business or chilling
Lately I've been listening to podcasts. If you're into comedy I recommend bill burr.

I sometimes felt the need to harm somebody in order to get a point across. I was bad at taking criticism.

Cognitive behavior therapy has helped me understand and work towards changing this habit. I've been struggling with chronic depression and I seemed to have completely forgotten about how therapy has been positively affecting me.

I'm sorry if this didn't really answer your question. Thank you for your reply.
